name: athena-eval-hierarchical-36
note: Focused 36-run single-pattern batch: the hierarchical pattern only, on 24 distinct prompts (12 core + 12 breadth) plus 12 repeats of the core prompts. Three prompts per category, twelve categories. It is a deliberate subset of the 72-run four-pattern matrix in evaluation/config.json, which is preserved unchanged and remains the full comparison. Nothing here is seed-reproducible: athena.run forwards no seed to any provider, so seeds are null and the variance tier is a stochastic replicate. Live runs MUST use --backend subprocess: the in_process backend redirects this process's stdout/stderr into a per-run log, which breaks MCP stdio toolset spawning and produced zero-evidence runs in results/20261106T194245Z.

pricing.note: Deliberately empty. The active model (groq/qwen/qwen3.8-27b) has no public list price and data/pricing.json lists it under 'unlisted' on purpose, so every run records est_cost_usd=null and cost_basis naming the unpriced model. Because costs are null, max_total_usd/max_run_usd CANNOT bound real spend for this batch - they are inert. The USD cap is not a spend safeguard here; max_runs=40 is the only hard attempt cap. Do not add an invented rate for this model.

plan.note: 12 core (one prompt per category) + 12 breadth (a second prompt in every category) + 12 variance (a repeat of each core prompt, repeat=1). Seeds are null: the pipeline never passes a seed to the provider, so the variance entries are stochastic replicates and their spread is sampling noise, not a reproducibility check.
